headline: An ordinary high schooler into CS & academia
bioMarkdown:
I started on a humanities track, previously working in graphic design and video editing, and later taught myself into computing. I have been in the field for less than a year.

My current work centers on reinforcement learning (RL), multi-agent systems (MAS), and large language models (LLM), carried through a few small research projects. Programming and security are both still early. In security I mainly know some cryptography theory; I am not yet familiar with the rest of the practice, and competitive programming is not my focus. I have recently taken part in AIS3 Junior and THJCC. I have not entered many contests, and the results so far are modest.

I am interested in both research and engineering, so I have studied some mathematics ahead of the curriculum. My mathematics is still developing as well.
